body:
_Migrated from issue #1356, filed 2026-08-04._

Found by the v4.1.29 pre-tag refuter gate. New user-visible state introduced by #1340's guard;
the underlying trade is defensible, the frozen display is the cost.

## Symptom

Mark a book Read while you are part-way through it — say 35%. `progress_percent` stays `35`.
The book page then shows a **checked Read box and `KOReader Progress: 35%` at the same time**,
and the Kobo is served `StatusInfo: Finished` with `ProgressPercent: 35`.

Since #1340 the web reader can no longer correct that number: every save below the 99% finished
threshold is refused for a book whose row says FINISHED. So the stale percentage is frozen
until the user marks the book Unread.

## Why it happens

`edit_book_read_status` never touches the percentage on the mark-read path — it sets status
only. Before this release the reader would have corrected the number upward on the next save,
but at the cost of clobbering the Read status back to in-progress, which is the bug #1340
exists to stop. So the guard is right; what is missing is that marking a book Read does not
also settle its progress.

## Fix direction

Have the mark-read path bring the position with it — set the stored percentage to the finished
threshold (or 100) when a book is marked Read, the same way marking Unread already calls
`reset_reading_position` to clear the ghost percentage (#683). That closes the loop in both
directions and removes the frozen state without weakening the guard.
title: Marking a book Read part-way through freezes a stale progress percentage beside the Read checkmark
